findings.summary: A review statement whose citation names an absent context item increments result.evidence_drops as well as being counted in review_drops at :291, so one removal is counted in both columns; the evidence fragment's 'code evidence / review removal' split therefore attributes review-side refusals to code filtering, and the reported evidence-drop count is not a pure count of the drafting filter's drops.

seal() rewrites seal.json unconditionally, so re-running `seal` after editing readings.jsonl replaces the digest that summarize() at :117 uses to refuse post-seal edits; the guard covered by tests/discovery/test_signal_enrichment_grounding.py:279 is one command away from being cleared, and the fragment's 'every digest precedes its key' claim rests on that unenforced convention.

VERDICT goal: the source brief's goal at brief.md:5-8 is correctness of the local model's descriptions against their given context, measured by hand against the paid model's existing descriptions; the landed change adds opt-in grounding, citation filtering, a local review pass, temperature and sentence-limit controls (imas_codex/discovery/signals/enrichment.py:179) and reports a sealed blind reading of 2/40 and 1/40 wrong beside the paid descriptions (private/report.json), so the goal is met and the best combination stated.
VERDICT done_when: brief.md:79-87 asks for the fragment's figures for baseline and each variant plus a rendered, looked-at figure saved through imas_codex.plotting and tests for each new option, the unsupported-statement drop and the second pass; the gate recorded in the manifest is a 96-test pytest run (head-injection-abbreviations.log:33) covering those tests, while the figure half is asserted by the separate figure record review-records/r-20261116T212212585198-ground-local-signal-descriptions-in-context.figure.json rather than by this gate.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest's orientation_write_paths and brief.md:99-106 name imas_codex/discovery/signals/, imas_codex/discovery/base/, imas_codex/llm/, pyproject.toml, scripts/, tests/discovery/ and the fragment and figure directories; all 13 files in `git diff --stat 21d0b6cc..2d50d54c` fall inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read in full; it records the commit list, baseline_suite 54 passed at EXIT=0 in base-suite.log, after_suite 96 passed at EXIT=0 in head-injection-abbreviations.log, the negative control in negative-verified-suite.log (5 failed, EXIT=1), the measurements in private/report.json, and rubric.* answered for all six dimensions.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit, 21 commits from 21d0b6cc to 2d50d54c over 13 files (enrichment.py +217, two prompt templates, four scripts, three test files, the evidence fragment and the SVG); the feature is opt-in per seat, and pyproject.toml is untouched.

SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: head-injection-abbreviations.log:33 records 96 passed and the log ends EXIT=0 at ba1910f2 with base-suite.log recording 54 passed, so the added-failure count is 0, while the figure half of done_when rests on the separate figure record review-records/r-20261116T212212585198-ground-local-signal-descriptions-in-context.figure.json rather than this gate.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in `git diff --stat 21d0b6cc..2d50d54c` lies inside the write paths at brief.md:99-106, and pyproject.toml, a declared path, is untouched.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: negative-verified-suite.log shows removing the citation-existence guard reddens tests/discovery/test_signal_enrichment_grounding.py:78 and :328 among 5 ids absent from the 96-pass head, though the empty-description refusal at :90 and the abbreviation cases at :461 are pinned only by fixtures the test itself supplies.
SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new helpers follow the module's existing function-local-import and render_prompt idiom (imas_codex/discovery/signals/enrichment.py:58,209), but enrich_signal_batch at :179 carries no type annotations where the rest of the module is annotated.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: prompts go through imas_codex.llm.prompt_loader.render_prompt and the figure through imas_codex.plotting.save_figure, and a search of imas_codex for sentence splitting found only the inline splitter at imas_codex/standard_names/audits.py:960, which lacks the abbreviation handling description_statements adds.
FINDING imas_codex/discovery/signals/enrichment.py:285 non-blocking: a review statement whose citation names an absent item increments evidence_drops as well as review_drops at :291, so one removal is counted in both columns and the fragment's code-evidence drop count includes review-side refusals.
FINDING scripts/assess_signal_enrichment_grounding.py:102 non-blocking: seal() rewrites seal.json unconditionally, so re-running seal after editing readings.jsonl clears the post-seal-edit refusal that summarize() at :117 enforces and that tests/discovery/test_signal_enrichment_grounding.py:279 asserts.
